import java.io.*;
import java.util.*;

public class Main {
    static final int MOD = (int) 1e9 + 7;
    static final int MOD2 = 1007681537;
    static final int INF = (int) 1e9;
    static final long LINF = (long) 1e18;

    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
        BufferedReader br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
        PrintWriter pw = new PrintWriter(System.out);
        solve(br, pw);
        pw.close();
    }

    static void solve(BufferedReader br, PrintWriter pw) throws IOException {
        StringTokenizer st = new StringTokenizer(br.readLine());
        int n = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
        int k = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
        int p = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
        int nn = n;
        int[] f = new int[n + 1];
        for (int i = 0; i <= n; i++) {
            if ((n & i) == i) {
                int t = 0;
                for (int j = 0; j < 20; j++) {
                    if (bit(n, j)) {
                        t <<= 1;
                        t |= bit(i, j);
                    }
                }
                f[t] = i;
                nn = t;
            }
        }
        if (n % 2 == 1) {
            pw.println(pow(k, n, p));
            return;
        }
        long[] fac = new long[n + 1];
        fac[0] = 1;
        for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
            fac[i] = (mult(fac[i - 1], i, p));
        }
        long[] ifac = new long[n + 1];
        for (int i = 0; i <= n; i++) {
            ifac[i] = inv(fac[i], p);
        }
        int[] a = new int[nn + 1];
        for (int i = 0; i <= nn; i++) {
            a[i] = (int) ifac[f[i]];
        }
        long res = pow(k, n, p);
        a = subsetPowConvol(a, k, p);
        submod(res, mult(a[nn], fac[n], p), p);
        pw.println(res);
    }

    static long pow(long a, long b, int p) {
        long r = 1;
        for (; b > 0; b >>= 1) {
            if (b % 2 == 1) {
                r = (r * a) % p;
            }
            a = (a * a) % p;
        }
        return r;
    }

    static long inv(long a, int p) {
        return pow(a, p - 2, p);
    }

    static long mult(long a, long b, int p) {
        return (a * b) % p;
    }

    static void submod(long& a, long val, int p) {
        if ((a = (a - val)) < 0) {
            a += p;
        }
    }

    static void addmod(long& a, long val, int p) {
        if ((a = (a + val)) >= p) {
            a -= p;
        }
    }

    static int bit(int n, int i) {
        return (n >> i) & 1;
    }

    static int bitcount(int n) {
        int r = 0;
        for (int i = 0; i < 32; i++) {
            if (bit(n, i) == 1) {
                r++;
            }
        }
        return r;
    }

    static int[] subsetPowConvol(int[] a, int k, int p) {
        int n = a.length;
        int logn = 19;
        int[][] fa = new int[logn][1 << logn];
        int[][] fb = new int[logn][1 << logn];
        int[][] fc = new int[logn][1 << logn];
        while (n != (n & -n)) {
            n += n & -n;
        }
        int[] res = new int[n];
        for (int i = 0; i < logn; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                if (bitcount(j) == i) {
                    fa[i][j] = j < a.length ? a[j] : 0;
                } else {
                    fa[i][j] = 0;
                }
                fc[i][j] = 0;
            }
            transform(fa[i], n, p, 0);
        }
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            int[] va = new int[logn];
            for (int j = 0; j < logn; j++) {
                va[j] = fa[j][i];
            }
            va = powConvol(va, k, p);
            for (int j = 0; j < logn; j++) {
                fc[j][i] = va[j];
            }
        }
        for (int i = 0; i < logn; i++) {
            transform(fc[i], n, p, 1);
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                if (bitcount(j) == i) {
                    res[j] = fc[i][j];
                }
            }
        }
        return res;
    }

    static void transform(int[] a, int n, int p, int invert) {
        int k = Integer.numberOfTrailingZeros(n);
        for (int i = 0; i < k; i++) {
            for (int msk = 0; msk < n; msk++) {
                if (bit(msk, i)) {
                    int pmsk = msk ^ (1 << i);
                    if (!invert) {
                        addmod(a[msk], a[pmsk], p);
                    } else {
                        submod(a[msk], a[pmsk], p);
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }

    static int[] powConvol(int[] a, int k, int p) {
        int n = a.length;
        if (k == 1) {
            return a;
        } else if (k % 2 == 1) {
            int[] r = powConvol(a, k - 1, p);
            int[] res = new int[n];
            for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
                for (int j = 0; j < n - i; j++) {
                    res[i + j] = (res[i + j] + (long) r[i] * a[j]) % p;
                }
            }
            return res;
        } else {
            int[] r = powConvol(a, k >> 1, p);
            int[] res = new int[n];
            for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
                for (int j = 0; j < n - i; j++) {
                    res[i + j] = (res[i + j] + (long) r[i] * r[j]) % p;
                }
            }
            return res;
        }
    }
}
